drafts.body:
Hello David Rubenstein Atrium at Lincoln Center team,

I’m writing on behalf of the Sabrina Audrey Milone Foundation (Smile Like Sab). We are exploring venues for our Manhattan Spring Gala, a proposed reception in New York, NY, for an estimated 150 attendees on April 17, 2027. The evening would honor Sabrina and include a short talk from a recovery speaker.

Could you please let us know whether the Atrium is available that date and suitable for this attendance? We would also appreciate information about capacity, pricing, any deposit requirements, catering options, and accessibility. Do you offer nonprofit rates or other accommodations for nonprofit events?

Thank you for your time. We would be glad to learn more about the possibilities.

Warm regards,
[Board member name]
Sabrina Audrey Milone Foundation (Smile Like Sab)
[Phone]

Dear NewYork-Presbyterian Center for Eating Disorders team,

I am writing on behalf of the Sabrina Audrey Milone Foundation (Smile Like Sab), established in memory of Sabrina Audrey Milone. Our focus areas are mental health awareness, eating disorder research and support, and community-building initiatives.

Your emphasis on research-informed eating-disorder treatment in a comfortable, supportive environment resonates with our mission. We would welcome the opportunity to learn more about your programs, their impact, and the needs you currently prioritize.

We are interested in whether you offer educational information that our foundation could share with its community. We would also appreciate understanding whether designated foundation support for the center is accepted and whether patient-support or research-related needs are among your current priorities. We are seeking information at this stage, without making a funding commitment.

Could you direct us to the appropriate team for a brief overview of these opportunities?

Thank you for considering our inquiry.

Warm regards,
